body.description: Edit ONLY the white masked regions containing the lower-left bronze axe warrior and the central pale skeleton. Repose each entire HEAD, FACE, SHOULDERS, TORSO, ARMS, held equipment and BOOTS to face a diagonal grid axis at 45 degrees. Make a substantial side of face and torso plus top of head or helmet clearly visible, matching the elevated isometric camera of the room; no flat front-facing face. Keep each figure the same compact scale and preserve its foot anchor on its original full 4:3 diamond tile; both soles must stay inside that tile. Keep the bronze axe and the skeleton sword/shield identities. Preserve the original palette, clear silhouettes, continuous tile lines, contact shadows and room. Preserve all black-mask areas pixel for pixel. Add no figures, stands, discs, pedestals, platforms or props.
